_meta.note: Static seed data for the MarineMax partnership demo. Prices, part numbers, stock and URLs are illustrative and not live commerce.

parts.name: Mercury Water Pump Impeller Repair Kit
parts.description: Complete water pump repair kit for Verado V8 outboards. Includes impeller, housing, gaskets, seals and wear plate — the parts that fail first when a tell-tale stream weakens.
parts.compatibility: Fits 2018–2024 Mercury Verado 300 V8. Confirmed compatible with your 2021 Boston Whaler 270 Dauntless.

parts.name: Mercury Water Pump Impeller
parts.description: Genuine Mercury replacement impeller. The single most common cause of Verado overheating and weak tell-tale — recommended every 3 years on outboards.
parts.compatibility: Fits Mercury Verado 300 V8 (2018+). Verified for your 270 Dauntless twins.

parts.name: Mercury Thermostat & Poppet Valve Kit
parts.description: Thermostat, poppet valve and gaskets. Replace alongside the impeller if overheating persists after the pump is verified — a stuck thermostat mimics impeller failure.
parts.compatibility: Fits Mercury Verado 300 V8 cooling circuit. Compatible with your 270 Dauntless.

parts.name: Mercury Verado Oil Filter
parts.description: Genuine spin-on oil filter for Verado V8. Change with every oil service to protect supercharger and valvetrain.
parts.compatibility: Fits Mercury Verado 300 V8. One per engine — order two for your twins.

parts.name: Mercury FourStroke 25W-40 Marine Oil (Gallon)
parts.description: FC-W certified synthetic-blend marine oil formulated for Verado outboards. Full-synthetic protection under supercharged load.
parts.compatibility: Recommended for Mercury Verado 300 V8. Plan ~7 qt per engine.

parts.name: Mercury Premium Plus Gear Lube (Quart)
parts.description: High-performance gear lube for outboard lower units. Milky drain fluid signals a failed seal — inspect at every change.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 lower units. One quart typically services each unit.
parts.relatedInterval: Lower unit gear lube change (each engine)

parts.name: Mercury Lower Unit Seal Kit
parts.description: Prop shaft and driveshaft seal kit. The fix when gear lube drains milky or gray from water intrusion.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 lower unit. Verified for 270 Dauntless.
parts.relatedInterval: Lower unit gear lube change (each engine)

parts.name: NGK Iridium Spark Plug (Verado V8)
parts.description: Iridium spark plug specified for Verado V8. Eight per engine — a fouled plug is the top cause of rough single-engine idle.
parts.compatibility: Fits Mercury Verado 300 V8. Order 16 for a full twin-engine set.

parts.name: Mercury Water-Separating Fuel Filter
parts.description: Primary water-separation barrier. Replace annually and inspect the bowl monthly for water accumulation.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 fuel system. One per engine.

parts.name: Mercury Fuel Filter Mounting Bracket Kit
parts.description: Replacement mounting bracket and O-rings for the water-separating filter assembly.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 fuel filter assembly.

parts.name: Mercury Aluminum Anode Kit (Saltwater)
parts.description: Complete sacrificial anode set for lower unit, trim tab and cavitation plate. Replace when 50% depleted — critical in saltwater and brackish water.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 outboards. Two kits for your twins.

parts.name: Mercury Trim Tab Anode
parts.description: Trim tab sacrificial anode. Inexpensive insurance against galvanic corrosion of the gearcase.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 gearcase trim tab.

parts.name: SeaStar Hydraulic Steering Fluid (Quart)
parts.description: Genuine hydraulic steering fluid. Top off a stiff or spongy helm; use when bleeding the system.
parts.compatibility: Compatible with SeaStar/Teleflex hydraulic steering on the 270 Dauntless.
parts.relatedInterval: Steering cable / hydraulic steering fluid check

parts.name: SeaStar Helm Seal Kit
parts.description: Helm pump seal kit for hydraulic steering that leaks or loses pressure.
parts.compatibility: Fits SeaStar front-mount helm used on 270 Dauntless.
parts.relatedInterval: Steering cable / hydraulic steering fluid check

parts.name: Mercury Marine Cranking Battery (Group 27M)
parts.description: Marine cranking battery for reliable Verado starts. The 270 typically runs a dual-battery system.
parts.compatibility: Sized for Verado 300 dual-battery setup on the 270 Dauntless.

parts.name: Marine Battery Terminal & Dielectric Grease Kit
parts.description: Tinned terminals, wing nuts and dielectric grease to keep dual-battery connections corrosion-free.
parts.compatibility: Universal marine 12V. Recommended for the 270 dual-battery system.

parts.name: Mercury Enertia Stainless Propeller (16" x 17P)
parts.description: Performance stainless prop tuned for heavier center consoles. Stainless dings can be repaired rather than replaced.
parts.compatibility: Common fit for Verado 300 on the 270 Dauntless. Confirm pitch with your usage.

parts.name: Mercury Flo-Torq Prop Hub & Nut Kit
parts.description: Prop hub kit, thrust washer and locking nut hardware for a secure, correctly-torqued prop install.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 prop shaft.

parts.name: Mercury Verado 100-Hour Maintenance Kit
parts.description: Bundled oil filter, fuel filter, gear lube and gaskets for a complete 100-hour service on one Verado.
parts.compatibility: Matched to Verado 300 V8. One kit per engine.

parts.name: Mercury Verado 300-Hour Maintenance Kit
parts.description: Extended-service kit adding spark plugs and water-pump components for the 300-hour milestone.
parts.compatibility: Matched to Verado 300 V8. One kit per engine.

parts.name: Mercury Storage Seal Fogging Oil
parts.description: Fogging oil to protect cylinders during layup. Part of the 270's fall winterization checklist.
parts.compatibility: Safe for all Verado V8 outboards.

parts.name: Quicksilver Fuel Stabilizer & Conditioner
parts.description: Ethanol-fighting fuel treatment for storage and everyday use. Add before layup and top-off.
parts.compatibility: Universal marine gasoline. Recommended for the 270 fuel system.

parts.name: Marine Motor Flush Muffs
parts.description: Dual-cup flush muffs to run fresh water through the engine after every saltwater outing — the cheapest overheating prevention there is.
parts.compatibility: Universal outboard fit including Verado 300.

parts.name: Corrosion-X Marine Corrosion Inhibitor
parts.description: Spray corrosion inhibitor for connectors and terminals. Part of the electrical winterization step.
parts.compatibility: Safe on marine electrical connectors and metals.

parts.name: Trailer Wheel Bearing & Seal Kit
parts.description: Bearings, races and seals for one hub. Wheel bearings are the most common trailer failure — repack or replace each season.
parts.compatibility: Common tandem-axle trailer fit. Confirm hub size.

parts.name: Submersible LED Trailer Light Kit
parts.description: Sealed LED trailer light set rated for repeated ramp submersion.
parts.compatibility: Universal trailer fit.

parts.name: Mercury Water Intake Screen Set
parts.description: Replacement lower-unit intake screens. Clogged screens are a first-check cause of weak tell-tale and overheating.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 lower unit.

parts.name: Mercury Tell-Tale Fitting & Tube Kit
parts.description: Replacement tell-tale nipple and tubing. Restores the visible cooling-water stream once the pump is serviced.
parts.compatibility: Fits Verado 300 cooling circuit.
